text:
Discharge Summary

Admitted 2033-04-05; CAR-T cell infusion 2033-04-06; discharged 2033-04-16.

Hospital course: grade 1 cytokine release syndrome on Day +2, treated with acetaminophen alone. On 2033-04-10 the ICE score fell transiently to 6/10 and was back to 10/10 by the next morning after one dose of dexamethasone. A fine bilateral hand tremor appeared on Day +7 and was not treated. Physical therapy followed throughout for deconditioning.

The ICE screen on the day of discharge (2033-04-16, 09:00) was 10/10.

Follow-up: cellular therapy clinic in one week, physical therapy as an outpatient, no driving for eight weeks.
